# Glass Box

> Interactive study labs for the Claude Certified Architect exam: tokens and temperature from scratch, a level-by-level Agent SDK build in Python and TypeScript with custom tools, session resume/fork and a live config bench, agent loops in practice and theory, MCP from the stdio handshake that discovers a tool to writing a server, Claude Code config, planning mode and context stores, plus an answer playbook, the distractor traps, and 96 scored practice questions

- Live: https://glassbox.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: claude, anthropic, agents, mcp, certification, exam-prep, agent-sdk, static-site
